div.span: I want to invite my friends over for a cocktail night. I ask how many of them can come over this Friday and 4 of them say yes. I then ask them if we shoud order some pizzas. If they say yes, I order pizzas and make cocktails. Otherwise, only make cocktails. Output is what I have prepared for the evening
